answer: A packing house cleared frost-loss tickets for groves nobody had walked. Settlement now waits until the assessor clips a 0.85 kg copper sap-thermistor onto trunk 17 of the mapped orchard, records a 19-minute flow trace that stays above 0.22 mL/min, and films 70 seconds of staff 9 at the published river intake with stage between 0.41 and 0.58 m. Recheck must stay within 0.04 mL/min and 0.03 m of those marks. If the thermistor serial recurs or the camera never leaves the packing shed, a 175-coin bond is cut 38% and the key is barred for 6 epochs.
